investigate.owns: Investigation: web research, code mapping, and any reading where the agent decides what the evidence means

decide.owns: Open decisions: any choice, approach, software design, design of complex functionality, taste, diagnosing unclear or cross-cutting bugs

synth.owns: Synthesizing complex, distributed, multi-faceted or conflicting work

build.owns: Decided implementation: well-defined modules, scoped UI implementation, "like this" examples, long build-test-debug loops

fix.owns: Fixes whose cause or repro is known

combine.owns: Merging groundwork toward one stated goal

code.owns: Very simple, fully specified, mechanically checkable code; blind, well-specified UI implementation

grunt.owns: Fixed-shape, zero-decision work: tabulate, count or extract named fields from named inputs, run a given command, checks, summaries, compaction
